test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) QM – VO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/546b881d0c8ec53ce981d8c0fa7c10bb4ee2dc7b4f4af6f0fffd98ec297ef9a7.png] 

Option 2) IE – NG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f08769a8acf26b614ac052ce6719cb978a8853c3025b2160388122aa344e4796.png] 

Option 3) GC – LF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac5e69bd2d74d48e146cc011baa540bc44ee51d33be2de1171f20331316d993c.png] 

Option 4) DZ – IB

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8eef431d5fb31337fd664e84da7eed39fb5056cc2f73f33e03bd75940b8244e6.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'GC – LF' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
